name: flyrank-ml-internship-jupally
title_zh: 13 个技能打包成一个仓库，按目录挑着装
tagline_zh: 不用挨个搜、挨个试、挨个配。一个仓库里躺着 13 个技能，翻目录看到哪个对路就装哪个，省下的是你逛店的时间。
tagline_en: Skip the hunt. One repo, 13 skills, browse the list and install what fits. Saves you the browsing time across.
why_zh: 它把散落的技能收拢成一套目录，装一个等于拿到 13 个入口。适合想批量扫货、又不想逐个翻仓库的人。
why_en: It bundles scattered skills into one catalog. Install once, get 13 entry points. For bulk browsing without visiting each repo.
limit_zh: 只提供技能清单和入口，不保证每个技能都经过深度打磨；装完还得自己逐个试效果，遇到不适配的得自己改。
limit_en: Only a list and pointers; no guarantee each skill is deeply polished. You must test each and tweak if mismatched.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: A pack of 13 skills in one repo, pick and install
